name: Cash App Business
description: Cash App business commerce is exposed to approved merchants and payment partners primarily through Cash App Pay checkout, merchant, settlement, dispute, and payout infrastructure. The documented partner APIs are not a general Cash App business-account balance, activity, contact, or peer-to-peer API.
agentUseSummary: Cash App Business cannot yet be connected through Relay. A supported integration requires Cash App partner onboarding and certification, client, brand and merchant configuration, API keys and webhooks, customer-visible authorization grants, payment and payout scope, settlement banking and reconciliation, dispute operations, and a checkout or POS product. Relay has no approved partner role, merchant, checkout, order, grant, amount, settlement, payout, dispute, or financial-authority contract.

blocked.label: Connect Cash App Business
blocked.description: An approved partner or merchant, certified integration, client, brand, merchant, API and webhook configuration, bank settlement, and reconciliation setup are required.

blocked.label: Present Cash App Pay checkout
blocked.description: Pay Kit, QR codes, app redirects, customer requests, payment grants, on-file authority, and merchant checkout remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Process payments or payouts
blocked.description: Creating, authorizing, capturing, voiding, refunding, settling, paying out, transferring, or otherwise moving money is blocked.

blocked.label: Access commercial records or disputes
blocked.description: Customers, grants, merchants, brands, payments, refunds, payouts, settlements, reports, fees, disputes, evidence, balances, and account activity remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Use private or credential-based access
blocked.description: Cash App or browser automation, password or session capture, unapproved API keys, private account APIs, and privilege probing are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Cash App Business action is enabled without one exact partner and merchant role, checkout, customer grant, order, amount, settlement, payout, dispute, and payment-control contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No Cash App Business tools are mounted before partner, merchant, customer-grant, checkout, monetary, settlement, dispute, and compliance controls are approved.

providerSetup.blocker: The official developer surface is Cash App Pay partner infrastructure, not a generic Cash App business-account API. It combines customer-facing Pay Kit, Customer Request authorization grants, server-side Network payment and merchant APIs, Management API keys and webhooks, settlement and dispute reports, and optional payouts. Partners can create brands and merchants, process and refund payments, manage durable customer grants, handle disputes and evidence, and send immediate payouts. Production onboarding requires Cash App's Partner Engineering team, bank and SFTP settlement configuration, and certification. A generic connector would combine customer authorization, merchant onboarding, payment and payout execution, settlement banking, disputes, and private commercial data without a defined partner or merchant role.
providerSetup.nextAction: Product, partnerships, commerce, payments, treasury, finance, legal, privacy, security, fraud, support, disputes, audit, and merchant owners must select one supported partner or direct-merchant product and freeze the client, brands, merchants, checkout or POS, customer grant types, orders, currencies, payment and payout limits, on-file authority, authorization, capture, voids, refunds, settlement bank, fees, reconciliation, disputes, evidence, webhooks, retention, audit, and incident duties. Cash App must then onboard and certify the integration. Only after that may Relay implement purpose-bound merchant tools with explicit customer authorization, idempotency, approvals for every money movement, reconciliation, audit, and post-disable denial.

evidence.supports: Cash App Pay combines customer-facing Pay Kit with server-side payment, merchant, credential, settlement, and dispute infrastructure.
A customer request must be approved to create a grant before the server-side Network API can process a merchant payment.
The partner Network API can manage payments, refunds, merchants, brands, customers, grants, disputes, evidence, and fee plans.
Production requires partner onboarding, settlement bank and SFTP configuration, reconciliation handling, and Cash App certification.
Approved merchants can send immediate payouts under customer grants, merchant validation, fees, settlement, and idempotency controls.
